## DPStyleARFootwearRendererInput class

Renderer input model for footwear virtual try-on. Provides independent tracking data for the left and right foot so each footwear item can be positioned and rotated per frame.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class DPStyleARFootwearRendererInput extends DPStyleARItemRendererInput 
```
**Extends:** [DPStyleARItemRendererInput](./stylearweblive.dpstylearitemrendererinput.md)
